messages.author: Hanna Kallio
messages.text: Lauri, AGG-014 has two BGP peers flapping, up for about five minutes and then down again. It started right after the firmware upgrade at 09:40.

messages.author: Lauri Ahonen
messages.text: Which version did it go to?

messages.author: Lauri Ahonen
messages.text: Did the upgrade bundle include a config change as well?

messages.author: Hanna Kallio
messages.text: Yes, the bundle carried new hold timers, 30 seconds instead of the old 90.

messages.author: Lauri Ahonen
messages.text: That is probably it. The peers behind the long-haul link need 90. Roll back the timer part of the config and leave the firmware as it is.

messages.author: Toivo Aaltonen
messages.text: Rolling back the hold timers on AGG-014 now.

messages.author: Hanna Kallio
messages.text: Still up after ten minutes, no flaps and the counters look clean.

messages.author: Lauri Ahonen
messages.text: Good. I will tell the vendor that the default changed.

messages.author: Toivo Aaltonen
messages.text: By the way, has anyone seen my phone charger? I think I left it in meeting room 3.
